# ”Det som investerare vill se”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon från 10 november 2026 handlar om en bred återhämtning på Wall Street och i Stockholm efter förra veckans nedgång, med AI/halvledare i spetsen (AMD +15 %, Caterpillar +7 %) och lägre kreditspreadar för CoreWeave och Oracle. Värdarna diskuterar riskerna kring Nvidia (Jensen Huang-affären, fyra utredningar, ett mindre vänligt politiskt läge). Sedan går de igenom nordiska rapporter: Scandic överraskade positivt efter två svaga kvartal, Ellos visade högre marginal och Lerøy slog förväntningarna trots lägre slaktvolymer. Värdarna uttrycker också skepsis mot att omvärdera storbankerna, kopplat till DNB:s höjda mål. Analysis text in English: The episode covers a broad rebound on Wall Street and Stockholm after last week's sell-off, led by AI/semiconductors (AMD +15%, Caterpillar +7%) with easing credit spreads at CoreWeave and Oracle, while Nvidia faces political/legal overhang from the Jensen Huang affair and four investigations. Nordic reports were mostly upbeat: Scandic beat after two weak quarters ('det här är det som investerare vill se'), Ellos lifted margins, and Lerøy beat on EBIT despite lower harvest volumes; hosts were skeptical of re-rating big banks after DNB raised targets.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q3 beat on adj EBITDA and RevPAR after two weak quarters; strong Swedish hotel demand; Finland still the weak spot.

#### Reasoning

The hosts framed the report as a turnaround quarter after two weak ones. RevPAR rose to 1,031 SEK from 966 and adjusted EBITDA of ~1.3bn SEK beat expectations. The CEO says the Swedish hotel market is strong. Their caveat is that Finland has been the drag, so this is a positive watch rather than an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Finland continues to drag results
- if hotel demand weakens with a macro slowdown next year

> *"Scandic Hotels har två rapporter i ryggen som har varit ganska svaga. Det här är det som investerare vill se."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO affair/possible spy issue, China chip concerns, four investigations, less friendly Congress from January.

#### Reasoning

The hosts worry that a Democrat-led Congress could revive old accusations. They also flag that four investigations could take up Jensen Huang's time and that his closeness to Trump may protect the company less. This is a speculative governance and political overhang, not an explicit sell call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if evidence emerges of chip sales to China linked to the affair
- if congressional investigations escalate in January

> *"Nu är det fyra utredningar som pågår mot Nvidia. Hur mycket tid kommer Jensen Huang behöva lägga på de olika utredningarna?"*
